ja: ナイトワールドを救う
２体の竜騎士が合体！
「SD ガンダムワールドヒーローズ THE LEGEND OF DRAGON KNIGHT」より

ゴールドとパープルの本体カラーはメッキとエクストラフィニッシュで再現。

en: save the night world

A dragon knight beyond legend appears, a fusion of Superior Strike Freedom Dragon and Alternative Justice Infinite Dragon!

The gold and purple body colors are reproduced with plating and extra finish.
●“Galaxy Original”
The ultimate final weapon that can be activated by deploying the chest armor.
It has the power to create galaxies and is capable of nullifying all phenomena.
